declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount} {hops fuel : Nat},
  SearchRouteDAG.Walk graph source target hops →
    hops ≤ fuel → (target, hops) ∈ SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateWalkEndpoints graph source fuel
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateWalkEndpoints_complete

declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount} {hops fuel : Nat},
  (target, hops) ∈ SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateWalkEndpoints graph source fuel →
    SearchRouteDAG.Walk graph source target hops ∧ hops ≤ fuel
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateWalkEndpoints_sound

declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount} {hops : Nat},
  SearchRouteDAG.Walk graph source target hops →
    (target, hops) ∈ SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateWalkEndpoints graph source (graph.maxRank - graph.rank source)
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.rankedDagFuel_is_complete

declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount}
  {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement} {budget : SearchRouteDAG.GraphRouteBudget}
  {routeCatalog : List SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute},
  SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.RouteCatalogComplete requirement budget routeCatalog →
    SearchRouteDAG.CandidateComplete graph source target requirement budget
      (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateGraphCandidates graph source target (graph.maxRank - graph.rank source)
        routeCatalog)
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.complete_walks_and_route_catalog_generate_complete_candidates

declarations.type:
∀ {stepCatalog steps : List SearchRouteCost.RouteStep} {fuel : Nat},
  steps.length ≤ fuel →
    (∀ (step : SearchRouteCost.RouteStep), step ∈ steps → step ∈ stepCatalog) →
      steps ∈ SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateStepLists stepCatalog fuel
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateStepLists_complete

declarations.type:
∀ {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement} {budget : SearchRouteCost.RouteBudget}
  {route : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute},
  SearchRouteCost.feasibleB requirement budget route = true →
    route ∈ SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.requirementRouteVariants requirement route.steps
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.feasible_route_mem_requirement_variants

declarations.type:
∀ {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement} {budget : SearchRouteDAG.GraphRouteBudget}
  {stepCatalog : List SearchRouteCost.RouteStep},
  SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.StepCatalogComplete requirement budget.routeBudget stepCatalog →
    SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.RouteCatalogComplete requirement budget
      (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateFeasibleRoutes requirement budget stepCatalog)
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.bounded_feasible_route_catalog_is_complete

declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount}
  {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement} {budget : SearchRouteDAG.GraphRouteBudget}
  {stepCatalog : List SearchRouteCost.RouteStep},
  SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.StepCatalogComplete requirement budget.routeBudget stepCatalog →
    SearchRouteDAG.CandidateComplete graph source target requirement budget
      (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateGraphCandidates graph source target (graph.maxRank - graph.rank source)
        (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateFeasibleRoutes requirement budget stepCatalog))
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.finite_step_catalog_generates_complete_candidates

declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type} (measure : α → Nat) {item : α} {items : List α},
  item ∈ items → measure item ≤ List.foldl (fun total current => total + measure current) 0 items
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.member_measure_le_foldl

declarations.type:
∀ {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement} {budget : SearchRouteCost.RouteBudget}
  {route : SearchRouteCost.SearchRoute} {step : SearchRouteCost.RouteStep},
  SearchRouteCost.feasibleB requirement budget route = true →
    step ∈ route.steps → step ∈ SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateRouteSteps budget
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.feasible_step_mem_enumerateRouteSteps

declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount}
  {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement} {budget : SearchRouteDAG.GraphRouteBudget},
  SearchRouteDAG.CandidateComplete graph source target requirement budget
    (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateGraphCandidates graph source target (graph.maxRank - graph.rank source)
      (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateFeasibleRoutes requirement budget
        (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.enumerateRouteSteps budget.routeBudget)))
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.budget_catalog_generates_complete_candidates

declarations.type:
∀ (padding : Nat),
  SearchRouteCost.evidenceTokenCost (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.zeroPaddedRoute padding) = 5 ∧
    SearchRouteCost.promptTokenCost (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.zeroPaddedRoute padding) = 8 ∧
      SearchRouteCost.rawTokenCost (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.zeroPaddedRoute padding) = 13 ∧
        SearchRouteCost.uncachedTokenCost (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.zeroPaddedRoute padding) = 13 ∧
          SearchRouteCost.roundCost (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.zeroPaddedRoute padding) = 2
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.zero_padding_cost_receipt

declarations.type:
∀ (padding : Nat),
  SearchRouteCost.feasibleB SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousRouteBudget
      (SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.zeroPaddedRoute padding) =
    true
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.route_budget_allows_unbounded_zero_cost_transitions

declarations.type:
∀ (limit : Nat),
  ∃ route,
    SearchRouteCost.feasibleB SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousRouteBudget route = true ∧
      SearchRouteCost.transitionCount route > limit
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.route_budget_has_no_transition_ceiling

declarations.type:
SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousGraphBudget
    { route := SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.zeroPaddedRoute (SearchRouteDAG.generousGraphBudget.maxTransitions + 1),
      graphHops := 0, pathValidated := true } =
  false
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.graph_route_budget_rejects_excess_zero_padding

declarations.type:
SearchRouteDAG.Realizes SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.oneNodeGraph SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.onlyNode
    SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.onlyNode SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.omittedRouteRealization ∧
  SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousGraphBudget
        SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.omittedRouteRealization =
      true ∧
    ¬SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.omittedRouteRealization ∈ SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.graphOnlyCandidates
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAGEnumeration.graph_walk_completeness_does_not_imply_route_completeness
